The development hereby approved shall only be laid out as 78 flats (4 x 3-bed, 36 x 2-bed and 38 x 1-bed) as shown on Drawing Nos. ENFL-MLA-CS-00-DR-A-00-11000-PL3, ENFL-MLA-CS-01-DR-A-00-11001-PL3, ENFL-MLA-CS-02-DR-A-00-11002-PL3, ENFL-MLA-CS-03-DR-A-00-11003-PL3, ENFL-MLA-CS-04-DR-A-00-11004-PL3, ENFL-MLA-CS-05-DR-A-00-11005-PL3. There shall be no deviation from the number, size or mix of units from that approved unless written permission is otherwise granted by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: Having regard to securing an appropriate mix in the number and size of units and having regard to securing an appropriate level of contribution(s), in accordance with adopted Policy.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details showing how the development will comply with the provisions of the Building Regulations (2010) (M4(2) approved under planning reference 25/00904/CND dated 18.12.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the development provides for the needs of future occupants and the adaptation of the dwelling to meet changing needs over time, in accordance with London Plan Policy D7, Core Strategy Policy CP 4, and Development Management Document Policy DMD 8.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of external finishing materials approved under planning reference 24/04088/CND dated 13.3.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance.

the development shall be carried out in accordance with the surfacing material details approved under planning reference 24/02815/CND dated 25.7.2025, unless otherwise sublitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the development does not prejudice highway safety and a satisfactory appearance

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed drawings of key thresholds, openings, parapets, typical bays and any other architectural features, approved under planning reference 25/00475/CND dated 4.3.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of roof structures and/or plant  approved under planning reference 25/04211/CND dated 17.2.2026, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writng by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In the interests of the appearance of the development and the visual amenity of the surrounding area including the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area

Having regard to condition 8, prior to the erection of any measures to screen the rooftop plant and lift overrun, details of such measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The screening shall be installed strictly as approved prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be permanently retained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In the interests of the appearance of the development and the visual amenity of the surrounding area including the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of means of enclosure for terraces and balconies approved under planning reference 25/02044/CND dated 27.8.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In the interests of the appearance of the development and the visual amenity of the surrounding area including the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area

AMENDED CONDITION 11Ba) The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details demonstrating how the development can achieve a minimum 'Secured by Design' Silver Accreditation approved under planning reference 25/04207/CND dated 9.1.2026, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. b) Within 3 months of first occupation of the development, 'Secured by Design' certification shall be obtained, and evidence submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interest of creating safer, sustainable communities.

Prior to the installation of any mechanical plant, an acoustic report must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The report must set out the sound level generated from the combined mechanical plant and state the noise control measures to be employed to ensure the noise from the combined units does not exceed a level of 5dB below background noise levels at the façade of the nearest or most noise affected residential property.Reason: To ensure there is not an unreasonable negative environmental impact.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the scheme submitted to deal with the contamination of the site including an investigation and assessment of the extent of contamination and the measure to be taken to avoid risk to health and the environment approved under planning reference 24/02815/CND dated 25.7.25, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To avoid risk to public health and the environment.

Having regard to condition 13, should contamination be found on site, remediation shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme and the Local Planning Authority provided with a written warranty by the appointed specialist to confirm implementation prior to the occupation of development. Reason: To avoid risk to public health and the environment.

If, during development, contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site then no further development on the relevant part of the site (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority) shall be carried out until the developer has submitted and obtained written approval from the Local Planning Authority for, an amendment to the remediation strategy detailing how this unsuspected contamination shall be dealt with.Reason: To protect against risks arising from contamination

All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA's supplementary planning guidance "Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition" dated July 2014 (SPG), or subsequent guidance. Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the local planning authority. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/Reasons: In the interests of good air quality

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of impact piling approved under planning reference 24/00753/CND dated 15.4.24, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: To protect the local amenity from noise and disturbance

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Construction Dust mangement Plan approved under planning reference 24/00352/CND dated 19.3.24. Reason: To protect the local amenity from demolition/construction dust

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Fire Strategy approved under planning reference 25/00904/CND dated 18.12.25, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed measures shall be implemented on site prior to the occupation of the development and permanently maintained. Reason: In the interests of the safety of future occupiers.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the tree protection scheme approved under planning reference 24/02819/CND dated 3.2.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the trees to be retained will not be damaged during demolition or construction and to protect and enhance the appearance and character of the site and locality.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the boundary treatement details approved under planning reference 24/02818/CND dated 11.10.2024, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. The boundary treatment shall be installed as approved prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be permanently retained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of visual amenity and the setting of the Conservation Area / non designated heritage asset of the New River

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the landscaping scheme approved under planning reference 24/02815/CND dated 25.7.25, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All landscaping in accordance with the approved scheme shall be completed /planted during the first planting season following practical completion of the development hereby approved. The landscaping and tree planting detail shall set out a plan for the continued management and maintenance of the site and any planting which dies, becomes severely damaged or diseased within five years of completion of the development shall be replaced with new planting in accordance with the approved details or an approved alternative and to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that the ecological value of the site is enhanced post development in line with the Biodiversity Action Plan, CP36 of the Core Strategy and the London Plan. To minimise the impact of the development on the ecological value of the area, to ensure the development provides the maximum possible provision towards the creation of habitats and valuable areas for biodiversity and to preserve the character and appearance of the area in accordance with adopted Policy.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the external lighting scheme approved under planning reference 25/00904/CND dated 18.12.2025.The approved lighting scheme shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and shall not be altered unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To prevent an indirect impact on bats using the river corridor to the east.

All areas of trees, hedges, scrub or similar vegetation where birds may nest which are to be removed as part of the development, are to be cleared outside the bird-nesting season (March - August inclusive) or if clearance during the bird-nesting season cannot reasonably be avoided, a suitably qualified ecologist will check the areas to be removed immediately prior to clearance and advise whether nesting birds are present.  If active nests are recorded, no vegetation clearance or other works that may disturb active nests shall proceed until all young have fledged the nest. Reason:  Nesting birds are protected under the Wildlife & Countryside Act, 1981 (as amended), this condition will ensure that wildlife is not adversely affected by the proposed development in line with CP36 of the Core Strategy

If at any time during the proposed works it becomes apparent that bats are present and at risk of direct impacts, works must cease until a licence from the Statutory Nature Conservation Organisation for development works affecting bats has been obtained and a copy submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that protected species are not adversely affected by the demolition in line with wildlife legislation.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of bat boxes and bird boxes approved under planning reference 24/04088/CNDdated 13.3.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Confirmation of installation as required by condition 26 has been provided and approved under planning reference 26/00645/CND dated 21.4.2026. Reason: To enhance the site post development in line with Core Policy 36 by providing suitable nesting features for birds and bats.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the green roof details approved under planning reference 25/02044/CND dated 27.8.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In order to ensure the biodiversity value of the green roof is maximised.

The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the revised Energy Assessment approved under planning reference 25/03915/NMA dated 27.11.25 which demonstrates that the project will reduce CO2 emissions by 82% compared to the baseline notional development within Part L 2013 Building Regulations, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure London is a carbon zero city via CO2 emission reduction targets accordance with Policy SI 2 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policy DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Within 3 months of first occupation, a final Energy Performance Certificate must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where applicable, a Display Energy Certificate shall be submitted within 18 months following first occupation. [Condition trigger amended  from 'Following Proactical Completion' to 'within 3 months of first occupation' under reference 26/00542/NMA dated 12.3.2026]Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Core Strategy, Policies SI 1 and SI 2 of the London Plan and the NPPF.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of mechanical ventilation, including its operation and extent, approved under reference 25/00904/CND dated 18.12.2025. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details and shall not be altered without approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In order to minimise the use of mechanical ventilation systems which are energy intensive and in accordance with policy SI 4 of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to first occupation of the development, the 3 disabled residential parking bays identified on drawing GA plan - Level 00 ENFL-MLA-CS-00-DR-A-00-11000-PL3 shall be provided on site. The spaces shall only be used for the parking of private motor vehicles for 'blue badge' residents and shall not be used for any other purpose.Reason: To ensure the development provides adequate on site car parking for disabled residents in accordance with Policy T6.1 of the London Plan 2021

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of EV charging approved under planning reference 25/02624/CND dated 3.10.2025. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and maintained as such thereafter. Reason: To promote the use of electric vehicles and reduce carbon emissions, in accordance with Policy T6.1 of the London Plan (2021) as well as relevant Core Strategy and Development Management Document policies.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Construction Management Plan approved under planning reference 24/00352/CND dated 19.3.2026, unless otherwise submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure construction does not lead to damage of the nearby public road network and to minimise disruption to the neighbouring properties.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of short stay cycle parking within the external parking/ courtyard area  approved under planning reference 24/02815/CND dated 25.7.2025. The cycle parking shall be installed prior to first occupation of the development and permanently retained for cycle parking. Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking in line with adopted Council and London Plan standards and policies.
Notwithstanding the submitted details, the doors to the cycle storage must be a minimum of 1.2m in widthReason: In order to ensure thy meet the minimum policy requirement

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Delivery and Service Plan approved under planning reference 25/04179/CND dated 6.2.2026, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the units are serviced without impacting on highway safety or causing unacceptable disruption to neighbouring occupiers and uses.

The glazing serving the west elevation of the southern block of the development indicated on drawing GA elevation - West ENFL-MLA-CS-00-DR-A-00-12003-PL3; shall be non-opening and in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range unless 1.7m above internal floor level. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the SUDs strategy approved under planning reference 24/02855/CND dated 25.4.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and the London Plan and the NPPF

AMENDED CONDITION:Within 3 months of first occupation of the development, a Verification Report demonstrating that the approved SuDS measures have been fully implemented shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. This report must include:o	Photographs of the completed sustainable drainage systemso	Any relevant certificates from manufacturers/ suppliers of any drainage featureso	A confirmation statement of the above signed by the site manager (or similar)Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and the London Plan and the NPPF

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of potable water approved under planning reference 24/02215/CND dated 11.7.2024, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in wrting by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To promote water conservation and efficiency measures in all new developments in accordance with the London Plan, CP21 of the Core Strategy and DMD58 of the Development Management Document.

No construction (excluding demolition) shall take place within 5m of the water main. Information detailing how the developer intends to build over, or divert the asset / align the development, so as to prevent the potential for damage to subsurface potable water infrastructure, must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with Thames Water. Any construction must be undertaken in accordance with the terms of the approved information. Unrestricted access must be available at all times for the maintenance and repair of the asset during and after the construction works. Reason: To ensure that the works do not have an adverse impact on nearby underground water utility infrastructure.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the piling method statement approved under planning reference 24/00753/CND dated 15.4.2024, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the proposed works do not have an adverse impact on nearby underground sewerage infrastructure

The development shall be carrie dout in accorndance with the details of a communal television system/satellite dish approved under planning reference 25/04179/CND dated 6.2.2026, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To mitigate the possibility of numerous satellite dishes being installed on the building hereby approved, in the interests of the appearance of the development and the visual amenity of the surrounding area including the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area

The development shall be carried out in accordnace with the details of ground levels submitted and approved under planning reference 24/03023/CND dated 5.6.2025, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that levels have regard to the level of surrounding development, gradients and surface water drainage.
